title: Quick Snappy Turkish Lamb Kebab Doner
description: A fatty and snappy Turkish dish featuring lamb, Sichuan pepper, and beurre-monte, perfect for a weeknight dinner
instructions: Preheat a large skillet or doner kebab pan over medium-high heat
In a small bowl, mix together Sichuan pepper, paprika, salt, and black pepper
Add the sliced lamb to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture
Add the melted beurre-monte to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom
Add the sliced onion to the skillet and cook until caramelized, about 5 minutes
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant
Add the coated lamb to the skillet and cook for 5-7 minutes, until cooked through
Warm the pita bread by wrapping it in foil and heating it in the oven for 5 minutes
Assemble the doner kebab by slicing the cooked lamb and serving it in the warm pita bread with diced tomato and caramelized onion
